Replay isolated at one pin seq (the org re-synced 130→136 mid-verification; the old code was re-baselined at 136 to separate code from environment): CONVERGED **221 → 225**, GROUNDING_AMBIGUITY 27 → 12, GROUNDING_OTHER 5 → 1, ZERO losses, req-315 byte-identical. Tree 4384 green; 8 new tests on `_world_multi()` / `_world_task_multi()` worlds mirroring env-59's real shape. **The standing lesson (recorded in the D-371 report):** a single-producer fixture world is not a model of a real org; any capability whose correctness depends on WHICH automation binds must be tested multi-producer. **Open follow-up (named, not folded in):** the 15 intents freed from the ambiguity gate now hit the effect-endpoint lexical miss (`Order__c` for `PLS_FB_Order__c`); attaching B0 recovery offers there would likely convert them to convergence — the next reachability slice. See D-371/D-372 (the program this corrects), D-318/D-299 (the attribution law), D-362 (B0).

## D-375 — S3: B0 grounded-recovery offers on the cross-object effect-ENDPOINT refusals — the D-374 named follow-up, closing the `effect_endpoint_no_offer` class. **The premise (D-374's open item, confirmed live):** breaking the multi-producer ambiguity freed ~15 real persisted req-320 intents to reach the NEXT failure — a lexical miss on the effect endpoint (the model guessing `Order__c` for `PLS_FB_Order__c` on `PLS_FB_Fulfilment_Task__c`). Those refusals carried ranked near-miss candidates as PROSE tails only (D-362 gave `_ground_cross_object_effect` the tails but not the payload), so the D-340 recovery re-prompt had nothing structured to follow and the offer-keyed convergence branch (`as_proposed.offer_entity_type == "Field"`) could not see them — they classified `LEXICAL_FIELD/effect_endpoint_no_offer`, un-followable by construction. **The change:** `_ground_cross_object_effect` returns a typed `_XoDeferral(detail, offer)` instead of a bare detail string; its three call sites pass `candidates=` through to `emission_deferred` exactly as the `effect_via_lookup_field` precedent shaped it — and that sibling (the D-227 parent-stamp path) is folded in too, its prose-only `via_tail` upgraded to the same structured payload. **Pools follow ownership:** the `effect lookup field`/`effect field` misses offer the EFFECT object's own BELONGS_TO fields at the pinned S1 seq (the missed name is asserted to live on the effect record — never the subject's inventory); the `effect_via_lookup_field` miss offers the SUBJECT's own fields (the via-lookup lives on the trigger record). **Laws preserved:** offers are FIELDS only, never automation names (D-318/B0, reaffirmed by D-362/D-374); the substrate discloses grounded alternatives and the model must re-propose — no silent substitution (a miss stays a REFUSAL with zero groundings, test-pinned); an unrecognizable name below the similarity bar yields NO offer, not a directory listing. **Validation (replay isolated per the D-374 discipline — env-59 re-synced mid-verification, corpus 1864→1895→1943; the OLD code was re-baselined at the same pin seq=136 before attributing anything):** the 15 effect-endpoint rows went from **15× `effect_endpoint_no_offer`** (old code, seq=136) to **13 `recovered` + 2 `offer_present_not_convergent`** (new code) — ZERO `effect_endpoint_no_offer` remain in the corpus; req-320 recovery yield 269→282 (+13), precision 581→594; as-proposed CONVERGED unchanged by construction (these recover via offer-follow, not first proposal); req-315 byte-identical (54/89). The one honest non-convergent via-lookup row is a mis-FRAMED intent, not a name miss (the model proposed an effect-object field as the subject's via-lookup — no field swap fixes a wrong frame); the offer is present and truthful, and convergence is correctly not claimed. Tree 4390 green (baseline 4384 + 6 new tests on the real FL04 fixture world: effect-object pool, subject pool for the via sibling, Field-only offers, no-silent-substitution, below-bar → no offer, determinism). The `effect_endpoint_no_offer` classifier branch in `convergence.py` stays as a backstop for any future offer-less endpoint refusal — now dead for these shapes by design. See D-374 (the program step this completes), D-362 (B0 recovery), D-340 (the re-prompt these offers feed), D-318/D-299 (fields-not-names), D-227 (parent-stamp).

## D-376 — Semantic resolution, first arc: shadow joint-evidence verifier at the subject chokepoint (SHIPPED) + wrong-but-real veto (designed, telemeter-gated) + subject-vocabulary-offer sketch (2026-07-21). **Problem:** the two subject-naming failure classes (D-362…D-375) have opposite tractability — lexical misses are recoverable (B0 closed them), but a wrong-but-real subject (`Order` for `PLS_FB_Order__c`) resolves SILENTLY and no shipped mechanism can see it (D-363: invisible to lexical recovery by design; v28 proved prompt prose can regress convergence). **Decision (from the 2026-07-21 first-principles architecture review):** the intent's OWN structural evidence discriminates — the field mentions and staged values the model already emits bind on the real object and not the imposter — so promote joint structural verification to a first-class, read-only observer now, and a gate later; the interaction doctrine is the proven **offer → select → verify** pattern (the B0 live record), never blind naming and never silent substitution. **Shipped (Slice 1, zero behavior change, no migration):** new cross-cutting package `primeqa/resolution/` (BusinessGraph/ResolvedGraph contracts; strict-label + Dice/trigram Phase-A candidates; Phase-B lexicographic-dominance joint solve — coverage > exact api/label > context > lexical, ties NEVER picked; grades BOUND_UNIQUE/BOUND_WEAK/AMBIGUOUS/UNRESOLVED; bulk symbol-table hydration per the D-189 pattern; `KnowledgeSource` seam with the single S1 implementation; consumes `SemanticOrgModel` only — new public read-only `connected_org_id` property). S3 adapter `generation/shadow_resolution.py` reconstructs the graph from v29 hints (`automation_name` never reconstructed, D-362); hook in `_resolve_one` immediately after `resolve_subject` (exception-safe, hydration-failure sentinel); verdicts ride `attempted_interpretation["shadow_resolution"]` on BOTH outcome kinds (`finalize_outcome` + `route_refusal` — the D-361 read-only-telemetry idiom; hash-safe by the four-fixed-keys property, test-asserted). **PROMOTION BOUNDARY (the D-361 language): recovery, prompting, and grounding MUST NOT read the verdicts; the one sanctioned promotion is the Slice-2 veto reading ONLY `would_veto`.** Offline tooling: `scripts/shadow_resolution_replay.py` (bypasses Layer A, so single-intent subject misses ARE covered offline) + `scripts/shadow_resolution_report.py` (aggregates + ambiguity persistence — the measured input to the DEFERRED glossary-pin decision). **Veto design (Slice 2, NOT armed):** `would_veto` is deliberately conservative — actual resolved AND winner differs AND winner BOUND_UNIQUE AND model binds ZERO veto-evidence mentions AND winner binds ALL (≥1) — PLUS two replay-derived suppression laws: (1) foreign-qualified mentions (qualifier names another object) are excluded from the veto-evidence set — they self-declare cross-object framing; (2) adjacency suppression — a winner reachable from the actual subject via a lookup is cross-object effect framing, not a wrong subject (and non-silent downstream: the field miss carries B0 offers). Shared vocabulary (a `Status` mention binding on both objects) also correctly stays veto-silent; all suppressed cases land in the `conflict` telemetry class — further tightening is a telemeter-gate decision, not a default. Arming rides migration 062 (`llm_enable_resolution_veto`, D-300 flag pattern) → `OperationalContext` → refuse via REUSED `RefusalKind.AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE` (a new enum kind = ALTER TYPE per tenant schema; the payload distinguishes) with D-374 field-discriminator disclosure + the winner in the B0 candidates channel. **Design doc:** `docs/architecture/specs/semantic-resolution-spec.md` (includes the Slice-3 subject-vocabulary-offer sketch, gated on shadow evidence; the free-graph prompt contract was REJECTED in review). **Validation:** unit tree 4434 green (baseline 4390 + 44 new: dominance/tie/fixture-trap tests incl. `Order__c`+`Priority__c`/`Tier__c` ⇒ `PLS_FB_Order__c` (3,3); adapter per hint family; `would_veto` truth table; wiring no-interference — a raising shadow leaves `_resolve_one` byte-identical; hash identical with/without the map). **Replay gate (PASSED, 2026-07-21, env-59 pin):** 1,671 intents (req-320 + req-315): agreement 75% overall with req-315 at 100% (76/76 agree — the mature corpus fully concurs); 359 `shadow_only` (misses the shadow can bind — 352 of them the `Order__c` guess, the recovery-relevant class); 60 `conflict`; would-veto 11/1,671 — the first-cut predicate fired 39 (9 TP + 30 cross-object FP), the two suppression laws above (derived FROM that replay) cut it to 11 = the 9 confirmed flagship `Order`→standard-`Order` TPs (discriminators `PLS_FB_Priority__c`/`PLS_FB_External_Ref__c`/`PLS_FB_Duplicate_Flag__c`) + 2 plausible TPs (`PLS_FB_Order_Line__c` subject with a `Status__c` mention it does not carry, winner `PLS_FB_Fulfilment_Task__c`) awaiting human adjudication; ambiguity persistence: NONE observed (the glossary-pin case has no measured support yet). **Exit gate (open):** one live telemeter cycle reviewed (incl. the 2 residual entries) before arming. See D-361 (the telemetry idiom), D-362/D-363/D-364/D-374/D-375 (the failure ledger), D-318 (effect-first binding — the doctrine this generalizes).

## D-377 — Field resolution, the F-arc (F0 telemetry+probe / F1 one-engine-full-scope / F2 value-evidence offers) — the AK-ratified next iteration after the D-376 live cycle (2026-07-21). **Redirect:** the first live shadow cycle showed subjects named correctly 14/14 (the wrong-but-real veto is a regression net with zero live samples — Slice 2 stays DELAYED per AK's ranking) while the FIELD-invention class stayed alive on a correctly-named subject (`Commercial_Tier__c`/`Total_Value__c`/`Line_Item_Count__c` binding nothing vs real `PLS_FB_Tier__c`/`PLS_FB_Order_Total__c`); the ratified plan: generalize the resolver to objects+fields and spend this iteration on fields. **F0 (read-only):** shadow verdicts v2 carry per-field records with hint-slot provenance (`shadow.fields[]`: term/slot/actual/winner fate ∈ exact|ladder|unbound; report script aggregates fate×slot); `scripts/field_resolution_probe.py` classified every corpus field mention at the seq-146 pin: **566 ladder-resolvable mentions NOT silently fixed today** (208 in REFUSE slots — condition clauses, invent-nothing — each historically a refusal+hop; **358 in DROP slots — trigger fields silently dropped by drop-never-refuse, i.e. WEAKENED staged tests**, dominated by `Status__c`→`PLS_FB_Status__c`) vs only 184 fixed by the narrow B1 rewrite; 596 unbound (`Commercial_Tier__c` ×127, `Order_Value__c` ×85…); 71 cross-turn hop recoveries. **F1:** the ladder's rules now live ONCE — `resolution/field_ladder.resolve_field_name`, a byte-parity port of the production B1 ladder (case-SENSITIVE rule 1, rsplit-last-segment bare, `__c`-only label strip — a naive mirror differs on all three; parity pinned by an adversarial matrix vs the live function), with both the governance wrapper and the solver delegating; `_canonicalize_subject_fields` extends the silent rewrite from field_name-on-two-kinds to EVERY subject-owned slot (trigger_field/trigger_fields/update_trigger_fields, rejection/acceptance/update condition fields + compared_to, effect_via_lookup_field); effect-object-owned slots untouched (D-375 ownership); rewrite ONLY on unique ladder resolution — misses keep every refusal/drop/offer path seeing the model's own words; shadow observes BEFORE canonicalization (raw-name telemetry). **F1 replay attribution (same pin seq=146, corpus 1971, old code re-baselined first per the D-374/D-375 discipline):** as-proposed CONVERGED **235→384 (+149; 12%→19%)**; LEXICAL_FIELD **591→389 (−202 ≈ the probe's 208)**; req-315 byte-identical 54/89; LEXICAL_SUBJECT unchanged 388. Two explained shifts, NOT regressions: KIND_MISFRAME 17→68 (name-masked intents now fail HONESTLY at the kind layer — kind-swap rescues 165/298 deterministically; the temporal-grounding test re-pinned to protect BOTH paths: the unresolvable near-miss still gets offer+framing, the suffix-class near-miss now canonicalizes to the semantic refusal); recovery precision 63%→53% is a survivor-population effect (~200 offers no longer NEEDED; total reachable convergence 521→574, +53). **F2 (offer-only — the ratified law: silent fixes stay ladder-only):** `_value_support_rerank` re-ranks an ADMITTED offer by structural value evidence — a candidate whose ACTIVE picklist carries the intent's own staged value floats to top-1 (bounded 2-hop per admitted candidate ≤3 S1 reads; stable partition; byte-identical when inapplicable/on any S1 error; payload entries carry `value_support: true`); wired at the value/automation-effect Layer-1 miss offer (`_named_ref_recovery` — `effect_value_hint`+`at_seq` were already in scope) and the state-transition to-state offer. **F2 validation:** replay byte-identical to post-F1 (no regression); a direct corpus fire-probe shows it FIRES on 70 real instances (`Priority__c='Standard'`×56/`'High'`×14) where the supported candidate was ALREADY lexical top-1 — confirmatory today, discriminating when lexical rank and value evidence disagree; placeholder sentinel values (`<recomputed tier>`) correctly earn no support. **Tree 4452 green** (4446+6). Ships with `scripts/field_resolution_probe.py`; replay/report scripts updated for verdict v2. See D-376 (the arc this continues), D-299 (drop-never-refuse), D-375 (offer ownership), D-340 (the re-prompt offers feed).

## D-378 — Field vocabulary surface (prompt v30): the org's REAL field vocabulary in front of the model BEFORE it proposes — the proactive half of offer→select→verify, closing the F-arc's semantic-distance residue (2026-07-21). **Problem:** the D-377 live cycle left 5/21 field mentions unbound on a correctly-named subject — `Commercial_Tier__c`/`Order_Value__c`/`Flagged_For_Review__c`/`Total_Line_Value__c`/`Line_Item_Count__c` are SEMANTIC-distance inventions no ladder rule can reach by construction, re-invented run after run (F0 probe: ×127/×85/×62/×24/×51 across the corpus); offers fix them only reactively (a refusal + an LLM hop). **Decision:** a retrieval-narrowed **ORG FIELD VOCABULARY** block in the initial user message — DATA built by the substrate (`generation/vocabulary.py` from the resolution SymbolTable at the pinned seq), never prompt prose: top-3 requirement-relevant objects, real field api names + labels + picklist values, custom-first (the FB-V1 inventory lesson), universal audit fields dropped, caps with DISCLOSED truncation (the D-362 anti-dump law), fail-soft to no-block on any failure. Ranking is COMPLETENESS-first — verbatim multi-word label presence (B0.1) → own-token coverage ratio → hit count — after the first live render caught raw-count ranking excluding `PLS_FB_Order__c` itself in favor of a CHANNEL_ORDERS package object (the D-364 class, caught pre-ship); the fix also shrank the block 4256→1649 chars (~412 tokens) and ALL 6 residue targets are LISTED. **Contract = frozen prompt v30** (authored via the working-source composition per D-089/D-103; hash recorded; CURRENT flipped): listed names copied VERBATIM; unlisted meanings keep the v29 field contract (best label + grounded recovery); FIREWALLED against the v28 regression class — the section "is vocabulary, not instruction" and "changes nothing about the subject-object contract" (29/29 live, untouched). **Version-gated end to end:** `registry.supports_org_vocabulary` (v30+) gates message assembly in `_initial_user_message`; every pre-v30 conversation — including replay pins via `operational_context.prompt_template_version` — stays byte-identical (test-pinned); `ConversationContext.org_vocabulary` defaults ""; `run_generation` hydrates the table once per batch fail-soft. **Validation:** tree green (unit suite; vocabulary builder determinism/caps/custom-first/fail-soft; registry hash guard incl. v30; v29 must NOT contain the section — frozen immutability). **Measurement honesty:** offline replay CANNOT measure a prompt change (it never calls the LLM) — the gate is the live A/B on the D-377 field telemetry (before: 5/21 unbound; the block lists the real counterpart of every one) with rollback = pin CURRENT to v29 (one line). See D-377 (the residue this closes), D-362 (anti-dump), D-364 (ranking-completeness lesson), v28/v29 registry history (the regression firewall).

## D-378.1 — D-378 EXIT GATE CLOSED: the v30 live A/B on env-59 (2026-07-21). D-378 named the live A/B as its gate because offline replay cannot measure a prompt change (it never calls the LLM). **Setup:** req-320 regenerated on env-59 at the same org/pin, one run per arm — v29 baseline outcome `82f7eee5-04d7-400e-b801-95e0aeabf743` (the D-377 cycle) vs v30 outcome `78a19f9d-9d82-43b4-8370-2da93ea5b563`; `llm_calls.prompt_version = generation@v30` confirms the deployed worker ran the new contract (the same self-verifying-deploy idiom as D-377's SHADOW_VERSION bump). **Result on the D-377 field telemetry:** field mentions 21→17; **unbound 5→2 (24%→12%)**; **all five semantic-distance inventions GONE** — `Commercial_Tier__c` / `Order_Value__c` / `Flagged_For_Review__c` / `Total_Line_Value__c` / `Line_Item_Count__c`, corpus-frequent at 127/85/62/24/51 occurrences respectively, none proposed once the real names were in front of the model. **Coverage moved the right way, verified not assumed:** claims_written fell 16→11 and equivalent_existing 14→6, which a naive read would call a regression — the AC coverage map says otherwise: **covered 8/16 → 11/16 (+3), refused 8→5**. v29 wrote 16 claims covering 8 ACs (heavy identity-dedup churn); v30 wrote 11 claims covering 11 ACs — less redundancy, more coverage. Subject naming unaffected as designed (11/11 agree, 0 vetoes, the v28-regression firewall holding). **The 2 residual unbound are NOT inventions:** both are `PLS_FB_Order_Line__c.PLS_FB_Order__c` in `effect_via_lookup_field` — verified against S1 as a REAL org field; it reads "unbound" only because the telemetry measures every attribute mention against the SUBJECT, and this one is foreign-qualified (the cross-object framing class F1's `_foreign_qualified` suppression already recognizes). Zero invented field names remain in the run. **Caveat, stated for the record:** N=1 per arm and generation is nondeterministic — the invention-class disappearance is strong evidence (five high-frequency names, simultaneous), the +3 AC coverage is directional and should be watched across subsequent cycles rather than treated as a fixed delta. **Disposition:** gate CLOSED, v30 stays CURRENT; rollback remains a one-line `CURRENT` pin to v29. Open follow-up (not blocking): the `effect_via_lookup_field` ownership lens — the shadow adapter files it under the subject while the model qualifies it with the effect object; worth settling when the cross-object arc is next opened (see D-375 for the ownership convention). ## D-379 — Phase A of the pending-backlog sequence: vocabulary lookup-adjacency + telemetry `foreign` fate + env-78 read_only + the D-378.1 lens settlement (2026-07-21). **A1 — relationship-adjacent vocabulary (the AC15 fix):** the live AC15 refusal ("no audit trail entity exposed") was a RETRIEVAL gap, not an org gap — `PLS_FB_Audit_Log__c` exists at the pin with a lookup to Order, but token-overlap ranking can never admit it (zero shared tokens with the requirement). `vocabulary._adjacent_objects` now expands the block with the top-ranked object's CHILDREN (objects whose fields reference it via lookup/master-detail), labeled "Related to <top> via lookup", capped `MAX_ADJACENT=4`, api-name-ordered. **Deliberately ONE direction** — the first live render showed the referenced-by-top direction dragging the 170-field User object in via OwnerId (the D-362 directory-dump class, caught pre-ship, same idiom as D-378's ranking catch); children pointing IN are where behavior claims about the top entity live. ## D-380 — Phase B: the rollup deterministic FALLBACK at the cross-object refusal gates (AC12/13 routing miss) (2026-07-22). **Problem:** FL07_Order_Rollup parses CLEANLY in the E3 bounded idiom (`_flows_producing_rollup` — Get Records correlated by the lookup → Loop → pure Add-accumulate → single unguarded parent update), but the E3 path only admits value-less, same-record-framed intents with NO `effect_object`/`update_trigger_fields`; the model's natural framing for "total updates as lines are added" is cross-object, so the intent fell into the cross-object arm — which searches producers on the SUBJECT (Order), finds none (FL07 triggers on the child), and refused at the SUB-3 `no_producer_floor` gate. A partial precedent existed (Completion E3's zero-own-flows tail attempt) but the live Order has 14 own flows, so the provisional bind skipped it. **Decision (AK: deterministic fallback over feedback-only):** at BOTH cross-object refusal gates (the SUB-3 no-producer gate and the D-306 update-observe gate), before refusing, retry `_try_rollup_resolution` on the STRIPPED framing (`_rollup_fallback` — drops `effect_object`/`effect_lookup_field`/`effect_field`/`effect_value`/`effect_via_lookup_field`/`update_trigger_fields`). **Every E3 law holds through the existing gates:** value-less only (a staged value keeps the refusal — a value-ful aggregate assertion is a different claim), exactly ONE producer (the unique-resolution law; ≥2 propagates the E3 ambiguity refusal, which is MORE honest than the generic no-producer text), full evidence derivation (staging plan + aggregate expectation + child VR-conflict gate). The reframe is DISCLOSED: `attempted_interpretation["rollup_reframes"]` (hash-safe by the four-fixed-keys property) records the dropped slots; on no-match, the refusal detail gains a reframe hint (the D-340 hop belt for uncatchable framings). **Validation:** 6 new tests on the real FL07 fixture world extended with an own-decoy flow (the live shape: subject has own flows, none producing the effect) — cross-object framing grounds via fallback with disclosure; update-trigger framing grounds; absence never reroutes; staged value keeps refusal + hint; zero-producer keeps refusal + hint; two producers propagate ambiguity. ## D-381 — Phase C: the CONDITIONAL-absence vertical (AC11 — "cancelling an order leaves already-completed fulfilment work unchanged") (2026-07-22). **The gap:** D-307's absence is strictly "NO correlated record at all"; a field-conditional absence refused at the stash gate AND the prompt taught the model to self-refuse it (`reason_source=model` on AC11, live). Yet every mechanical piece existed: the E2 set-update path already stages related children + trigger + filtered read + `count_equals`; S4 needs NOTHING (before-state capture stays a D-203 residual — "unchanged" is encoded snapshot-free as "the protected row still matches its staged value"). **Decision (AK: build in-sequence):** the conditional absence RIDES THE E2 RAILS. Hint shape: `expected_absence: true` + BOTH `effect_field`/`effect_value` as the protecting condition (a half-pair refuses). **The grounding law — exclusion by what the op itself declares (the D-374 spirit):** grounds ONLY when the bound update-producer's own op filter pins the condition field to a DIFFERENT value (FL05's `Status EqualTo 'Open'` provably excludes `'Completed'`); a blanket fan-out (no pin) or a pin equal to the protected value refuses ("not provably scoped"). Producer selection: UPDATERS only (creators/async are irrelevant to "unchanged"; value-narrowing would kill the match since the protected value is deliberately NOT what the op writes); exactly one, else ambiguity refuses. **Recipe** (`create-protected` between the subject create and the trigger): stage ONE protected child — the op's own filter template with the condition field pinned to the protected value, maximally adversarial (identical to the fan-out's targets except the pin) — fire the entry transition (derived from the op guard, the E2 machinery), read `WHERE lookup AND field=protected`, assert `count_equals(1)`. **Claim body v3** (`AutomationConditionalAbsenceClaimBody`, registered `automation-effect-claim@3`): a NEW version, not a v2 field — the D-306.1 law (extending v2 would re-key every existing absence claim); `protected_field`/`protected_value` are first-class identity. **S6:** new vocab `automation-effect-claim@conditional-absence` (passed = `automation_exclusion_confirmed`, failed = `protected_record_mutated`), selected on `count_equals` + the evidence-borne `create-protected` step (evidence discriminates, never the claim). **Prompt v31** (frozen via composition, hash `799457d0…`, CURRENT flipped; rollback = pin v30): the D-307 "field-conditional absence is refused" paragraph becomes the conditional-absence contract. **Validation:** 8 new tests on the real FL05 fixture (grounds + entry transition Status→Cancelled; emission shape + v3 identity determinism; half-pair refuses; blanket-fan-out refuses; protected==scope refuses; two-updater ambiguity; plain absence unchanged; interpreter vocab on real evidence shapes); registry-population pin extended DELIBERATELY (@3). Tree 4477 green. **Replay: BYTE-IDENTICAL both corpora** — no historical intent ever carried the shape (v15+ forbade it); zero regression, the value elicited live by v31. Exit gate (open): live cycle 3 — AC11 expected covered. See D-307 (the plain absence this extends), D-306.1 (the body-version law), D-374 (the exclusion-proof spirit), Completion E2 (the rails).

## D-382 — Phase D (SUB-4): S6 stops inventing metadata — UNKNOWN propagates, attribution says "I don't know" (2026-07-22). **The defect (review SUB-4, still-valid):** `interpretation/s1_reader.py` fabricated affirmative defaults on MISSING detail rows (`is_active=True`, `is_createable=True` via `details.get(k, True)`), so cause attribution was computed on metadata that was never read — and the truthiness consumers compounded it (a None would have read as "inactive"/"not createable", accusing the org of states nobody observed). **Fix (the review's Option A):** the three reader sites propagate `None`; `VrMeta.is_active`/`FlowMeta.is_active`/`FieldMeta.is_createable` become `Optional[bool]`; every consumer compares `is True`/`is False` explicitly: the bound-flow site emits the NEW `grounding_incomplete` cause on None ("cannot distinguish deactivated from entry-condition-unmet"); the all-flows site distinguishes provably-none-active (still `automation_inactive`) from none-active-with-unknowns (`grounding_incomplete`); a violated VR with unknown state buckets INDETERMINATE (never "inactive"); `field_not_createable` and `before_save_automation_overwrote` accuse only on provable `False`/`True` (None = honest pass-through). `grounding_incomplete` added to the `CauseKind` registry (no repair mapping ON PURPOSE — you cannot repair metadata you have not read; the repair agent's dict lookups degrade gracefully). **Validation:** new `tests/unit/interpretation/test_s1_reader.py` (missing detail rows → None, never True; present rows keep real booleans) + 3 attribution cases (unknown-VR → not vr_inactive; unknown-flow → grounding_incomplete; unknown-createability → no accusation); interpretation suite 144 green; tree 4482 green (4477+5). No replay gate (S6 is downstream of generation; replay never runs interpretation). Watch item: the next live runs may surface grounding_incomplete causes — that is the fix WORKING (honest surfacing of the sync detail-row gaps), not a regression. See PLIMSOL_FIX_PLAN SUB-4, D-229/D-241 (the attribution machinery), the 2026-07-21 architecture review (which flagged invented metadata as load-bearing for any future catalog work).

## D-383 — Phase E (SUB-1): the entry-gate staging becomes CLAIM TRUTH — automation-effect claims author their trigger conditions as semantic_conditions (2026-07-22). **The defect (review SUB-1, Wave-3 NEEDS-DECISION, AK-approved):** every automation-effect emission persisted `semantic_conditions: []`; the staged entry state (`trigger_fields` / `update_trigger_fields` — WHAT must hold for the flow to fire) rode only recipe bodies + prose, invisible to S2 readers, S6/S8 evolution, coverage extraction, and the decision layer. **Fix:** `_trigger_conditions(g)` authors the staging as `equals` clauses on all five automation-effect emission shapes (mainline same-record/cross-object, rollup, E2 set-update, premise-conditioned, conditional-absence): the transition's INTO-state wins a shared field over the create staging (the truth the effect fires UNDER), None values and duplicate fields never author, subject-sorted for deterministic identity, refs pinned at `g.version_seq`. **THE IDENTITY CONSEQUENCE — deliberate and pinned by test (the D-339/D-353 lesson):** `semantic_conditions` feed `compute_identity_hash`, so a staged automation-effect claim regenerated post-D-383 gets a NEW identity (the persister's dedup no longer collapses it against the pre-D-383 row) — an un-deprecated old claim would survive as a duplicate-active. **Migration law: deprecate-then-regen per requirement** (the D-353 mechanism via `s4_execution_console.deprecate_claim`, humans-only per D-ε-1): the live gate executes it for req-320; other requirements migrate the same way at their next regeneration — regenerating WITHOUT deprecating first will duplicate staged automation-effect claims until done. **Validation:** 3 new tests (staging→conditions with update-wins/sort/dedup laws; the re-key pinned INTENTIONALLY — staged vs unstaged now hash apart, same grounding still deterministic; None/dupe hygiene); tree 4485 green (4482+3); no replay identity movement expected on as-proposed codes (conditions change PERSISTED identity, not resolution). Exit gate (open): live cycle 4 — deprecate req-320's active automation-effect claims, regenerate, verify conditions-bearing claims + zero duplicate-actives + coverage holds. See SUB-1 (the finding), D-339/D-353 (the identity/dedup laws), D-058 §5 (ref pinning).

## D-384 — `matches_pattern` becomes VALUE-FREE at the conditions layer: the org owns the format; model-invented placeholder spellings stop minting claim identities (2026-07-22). **The defect (live, req-320):** req-320 accumulated 11+ byte-identically-titled prohibition claims ("Rejects editing fields on PLS FB Order when External Reference matches the required format") because `rejection_conditions` values are identity-bearing (D-293) and the S2/S3 coupling makes `matches_pattern` value-REQUIRED — but the required format is the ORG's constant (the grounding VR's REGEX), so the model has nothing true to supply and invents a different placeholder spelling each regeneration. Live corpus (tenant_1): 22 persisted rows carry `matches_pattern` clauses; the flagship group — `PLS_FB_Order__c` `modify_field` — holds **16 rows across 13 distinct stored identities whose ONLY difference is the invented spelling** (`<invalid-format>`, `<invalid format>`, `<invalid_format>`, `<invalid-format-example>`, `<invalid_format_example>`, `<invalid pattern>`, `<not matching required format>` (the approved survivor), `<required-format-negated>`, `<UNKNOWN - invalid format>`, `<UNKNOWN required format - not stated>`, `INVALID`, `INVALID_FORMAT`, `invalid-format`); `PLS_BM_Deal__c` is accruing the same class (drafts `invalid_format` / `<org-defined format>` / `<org-required-format>` / `<UNKNOWN>`), and an approved `Opportunity` claim carries `">10000"` as a "pattern". Each spelling mints a new `identity_hash`, so the D-339 persister dedup CANNOT collapse them — the dedup is working as designed; the coupling that forces the invented input is the defect. **Root cause — the coupling forces a division-of-responsibility violation.** The `matches_pattern` condition value has exactly ONE consumer in the entire system: `compute_identity_hash`. Verified inventory: prohibition conditions are never staged (identity/display only, `_bind_picklist_values` docstring); acceptance/update clauses REFUSE `matches_pattern` as unstageable (equals/is_null-only bar, D-305/D-306); `_align_vr_to_conditions` reads FIELDS only (D-295); `_constraint_states` leaves `matches_pattern` UNKNOWN (D-350); the D-337 staged-VR-conflict guard and the S4 k16 guard (`run.py`) read equals/is_null only; titles + readable bodies render "matches the required format" WITHOUT the value. So the value is identity-bearing noise the model is FORCED to invent — the exact inverse of the law the prompt already states for thresholds and lock-mutations ("you name the behaviour, the substrate supplies the mechanics"). **Decision (Option B — the substrate enforces the boundary, not the prompt).** (1) **S2:** `matches_pattern` moves from value-REQUIRED to value-OPTIONAL in `Condition` + `ConditionV2` (`models/conditions.py`, a `_VALUE_OPTIONAL_PREDICATES` class). OPTIONAL, not forbidden: persisted bodies re-validate through the Pydantic models on every read (`coordinator._deserialize_body`), so forbidding the value would crash every legacy row that carries one. No `body_schema_version` bump and no `IDENTITY_HASH_VERSION` bump: no field is added or removed (contrast D-330, where a NEW field forced conditions v2) and the canonical output of every existing valid body is unchanged — admission widens, policy doesn't move (the D-293 "richer inputs, same policy" precedent). (2) **S3:** `_ground_rejection_conditions` — the single chokepoint all three clause ingresses share (rejection / acceptance / update) — DROPS any proposed `matches_pattern` value (normalized to None before grounding), drop-never-refuse (the `_ground_trigger_fields` posture; Guardrail 2 / invent-nothing): the substrate enforces the division of responsibility rather than hoping the prompt holds. A value-LESS `matches_pattern` proposal — refused "requires a value" until today, i.e. the model was PUNISHED for honouring the division of responsibility — now grounds. Shadow telemetry still sees the raw proposal (observation precedes canonicalization, D-377 ordering). Acceptance clauses keep refusing `matches_pattern` downstream (unstageable, D-305) — outcome unchanged. (3) **Prompt v32** (frozen composition, CURRENT flipped; rollback = pin v31): the clause taxonomy names `matches_pattern` value-free — the org defines the format; never invent a sample value; the substrate derives the concrete format and the violating input from the org's own rule, exactly as with thresholds. (4) **Recipe layer untouched:** the violating payload derives from the VR formula (D-294/D-295), never from condition values; the recipe-side `AssertionPredicate.matches_pattern` stays value-bearing (operational, executable — a deliberately separate taxonomy). **Rejected Option A (extend `_scrub_placeholder_values` to condition values).** The angle-bracket detector misses 5 of the live spellings (`INVALID`, `INVALID_FORMAT`, `invalid-format`, `invalid_format`, `">10000"` — none bracketed); a placeholder lexicon is unbounded against free invention; and under the value-required coupling a scrub-to-None flips to the "requires a value" REFUSAL — trading duplicate identities for lost coverage while leaving the root cause (the coupling forces invention) in place. Corpus check: ZERO placeholder-class values on any other predicate (equals/not_equals/in_set values are requirement-named business vocabulary the model legitimately owns) — the fix is exactly `matches_pattern`-scoped; no wider scrub is warranted. Proposal-history check (`tenant_1.llm_calls`, all propose turns): **137 `matches_pattern` clauses proposed, 25 distinct invented spellings, ZERO value-less** — the model never converged on a spelling (a scrub lexicon chases an unbounded tail), and no historical proposal exercises the one admissible resolution flip (value-less refuse→ground), so replay resolution is byte-identical on the full corpus by construction. **THE IDENTITY CONSEQUENCE — deliberate re-key of this claim class (the D-383 lesson, pinned by test).** All spellings of one `(field, matches_pattern)` state now mint ONE identity, so the persister dedup collapses future regenerations — but a post-fix regen will NOT dedup against a pre-fix value-bearing active claim (hashes differ). **Migration law: deprecate-then-regen per requirement (D-353/D-383)** for the 6 current non-deprecated carriers: approved `PLS_FB_Order__c` `16577ae7`/hash `7b28ed0b`, approved `Opportunity` `49b2070d`/hash `3d347b54`, and the 4 `PLS_BM_Deal__c` drafts (`46b8cb9d`, `abf482ee`, `b182dbab`, `d33a5f29`). Regenerating without deprecating first duplicates exactly once more, then never again. **The identity audit (read-only, `scripts/matches_pattern_identity_audit.py`; run 2026-07-22 pre-impl):** sanity replay 22/22 (every stored hash reproduced through the live canonicalization — the audit computes real identity, not an approximation); under the normalization the 22 rows' **19 distinct stored identities collapse to 6 (−13)**: the `PLS_FB_Order__c` group 13→1, `PLS_BM_Deal__c` `modify_field` 2→1, four singleton groups unchanged. **Verification gates:** unit — S2 coupling (value-free `matches_pattern` valid on v1+v2; legacy value-bearing still parses; equals/not_equals/in_set still require; is_null still forbids), S3 drop (distinct spellings ground to the SAME grounded condition and identical `identity_hash` through emission; value-less grounds; acceptance still refuses unstageable), prompt v32 hash guard + CURRENT; full tree green — **observed: 4492 green** (4486 baseline − 2 reparametrized + 8 new: 4 S2 coupling, 1 S3 drop, 3 identity pins through `_ground_rejection_conditions` → `author_emission` → `compute_identity_hash`); the post-impl audit re-run reproduces 22/22 sanity + the same collapse counts (legacy rows parse under the widened validator). Replay: resolution outcomes cannot move on value-bearing historical proposals by construction (the dropped value feeds no resolution gate — the inventory above); the only admissible flip is value-less `matches_pattern` refuse→ground, with zero historical instances (the 137/0 proposal-history check). Exit gate (open): deprecate-then-regen the 6 carriers on env-59 at their requirements' next regeneration; verify ONE value-free claim per behaviour, zero duplicate-actives. See D-293 (conditions became identity-bearing) · D-339/D-353 (dedup + deprecate-then-regen) · D-383/D-383.1 (the staging→conditions re-key + identity-safe coercion precedents) · D-294/D-295 (the VR-derivation rail that owns org constants) · D-330 (the body-version law this does not trip) · D-305/D-306 (the stageability bar that keeps `matches_pattern` out of staged paths).

## D-385 — S3: two wrong-red generators closed by the first full req-320 TEST-RUN (18 pass / 5 fail, 2026-07-22) — an Update-trigger producer must never author a create-only recipe, and a Sum roll-up must never stage a formula field. **The evidence (live env-59 execution):** claim bf889825 (FL09 audit-log, generated THAT morning by v31) created the order AT Fulfilled and read the audit log — 0 rows after 3 attempts: FL09 fires on UPDATE leaving Fulfilled, and the recipe carried no update step, so the claim was red BY CONSTRUCTION. Claim 87f86ec6 (FL07 Sum roll-up) staged `PLS_FB_Line_Total__c=137` on the order lines — Salesforce rejected the create with INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE: the field is a FORMULA (`is_calculated`, `is_createable=false`), which S1 knew all along; the E3 gate checked numeric TYPE but not writability. (S6's "FLS / permission" cause on that run was wrong — not permissions, unwritable by definition.) **Fix 1 (E1 transition derivation):** the guard grammar gains `NotEqualTo` — on an Update-trigger producer a `f != v` guard is the LEAVING-a-state arm (FL09: current != Fulfilled with prior == Fulfilled on the same path), so the staging is create AT the excluded state, update AWAY to a picklist alternative — the prior-state semantics fall out for free (prior == v ∧ current == alt != v), no IR change needed. And the closing law: **an Update-trigger producer whose transition cannot be derived REFUSES** (named: "fires on UPDATE only … a create-only test can never trigger it") — the silent fall-through to create-only emission was the wrong-red generator. Absence keeps its own rails (create-only is exactly absence's shape). **Fix 2 (E3 Sum gate):** `is_calculated` / `is_createable=false` on the source field refuses at grounding with the real reason; staging the formula's INPUT fields is a named future capability, never a guess. The Count twin (stages nothing) is pinned unaffected — it passed live (c6c4d1e1). **Replay (same-seq isolation, old code re-baselined at seq 148):** req-320 CONVERGED 462 → 455 — trace-diffed: ALL 7 losses are the formula-field Sum class, i.e. historical proposals that "converged" into exactly the claim shape that failed red live — false convergences, now honest refusals (classifier: both new refusal texts land in GROUNDING_WITNESS, not the catch-all). The FL09 guard cost ZERO replay convergence — those intents now converge into CORRECT create-then-update recipes. req-315 66/109 byte-identical. ## D-386 — S3: the D-385 law applied to the STATE-TRANSITION claim kind — the residual found while verifying D-385 on env-59 (2026-07-22). **The evidence (live):** the post-D-385 regen (job 91, outcome 8995224f, 08:14) minted claim 78a2d330 (state-transition-claim, draft): from_state `Status='Confirmed'` → to_state `Reopened=true`, recipe create(Status=Confirmed) → read(Reopened) → assert — NO update step; FL09_Reopen_Guard sets `PLS_FB_Reopened__c` only on UPDATE leaving Fulfilled, so the test was red BY CONSTRUCTION (the same class as the 07-12/13 deprecated 632f9286/7a3a4de8, also state-transition kind; 78a2d330 deprecated with the reason in provenance). D-385 closed the hole in the AUTOMATION-EFFECT path only; the `GroundedStateTransition` rails (D-210.1/D-222) carried their own version: the D-222 staged-trigger shape BYPASSED the T4 producer check entirely (grounded on BELONGS alone), and even the bare shape's T4 counted an Update-only producer as a valid create producer. **Fix (three arms at the state-transition stash gate, same-record shape only — the D-227 cross-object trigger is a separately verified shape, unchanged; the D-385 precedent):** (1) the C5 transition derivation is EXTRACTED into the shared `_derive_transition_staging` (reuse, not duplication — the automation-effect C5 site now calls it, byte-identical refusal texts) and the state-transition resolver runs it when exactly ONE grounded transition arm matches (field, to_value): the arm's prior-state guard becomes the CREATE, its current guard the UPDATE (EqualTo → the literal; NotEqualTo → a picklist alternative; entry_changed_fields must genuinely change), staged as new `transition_create_fields`/`transition_update_fields` on `GroundedStateTransition`; the derived staging SUPERSEDES the model's D-222 pair (dropped, never merged — the org's guard owns the transition, the drop-never-guess posture). Stash-parity guard rails with C5's merge: BELONGS at the pinned version, D-306.1a updateable on the update fields, the D-337 staged-VR overlay; >1 arms → cannot-attribute. (2) Derivation failure → NAMED refusal ("produces the to-state on UPDATE only, and the update that fires it cannot be staged: …") — never author create-only. (3) When NO grounded arm exists but EVERY raw-verifiable producer of (field, to_value) fires on Update only → refuse ("a create-only test can never trigger it") for both the bare AND the staged shapes. **Emission:** `_author_state_transition` authors create(prior) → update(away) → read → assert on the existing `_observe_steps` update phase (the D-306 machinery — no new step vocabulary); from_state IS the arm's prior state (org-owned, identity-bearing); the update is the causal event (`operation="update"`, "… then updating …" narration, the D-327 idiom).
